title: Uka jamasat apthapiñ uñjirinaka
intro: Chʼojjña oraqenjja, mä tama jaqenakaw chʼamakan jamasat mä amtar puripjjäna. Jupanakajj mä amtanikïpjjänwa, ukampis amtapajj janiw cheqapäkänti. Jupanakajj janiw yatipkänti, ikipkäna ukhajj mä divin turkakipäwiw jupanakar suyaskäna.
clues: Amtäwijajj jan pantjasirïkaspas ukham amuyasaw mä amtar puripjjta.
Nayratpach mistuñ amtapjjayäta, janïr mayninakajj chʼalljjtayasipkipan.
Mä suma parcelaruw sarapjjta, manqʼañanakajaruw confiyapjjta.
Kawkirutï sarapjjañajäkäna uka cheqar puripkayäta ukhajja, jan wawani ukat chʼusa cheqaw jikjjatasipjjerïta, ukatwa thak aptʼasipjjta sasaw amuyapjjerïta.
Ukat chiqpachansa ukax jiwasan chiqajäkaspas ukhamaw amuyasipxta, ukat jan suyt’ataw arnaqasipxta, chhaqhatajat maynit maynikamaw juchañchasipxta.
Uka alwax juramento lurapxta, pisinkirinakar yapu apthapiñat jaqunukuñataki, ukampis Allahan castigopax ikiñkamaw purinipxitu, jardinajaruw t’unjapxitu.

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
